defs.def: to stay where you are or delay doing sth until sb/sth comes or sth happens 等；等待；等候

ex.s: She wrapped herself in a blanket, waiting for morning.
ex.t: 她裹上毯子，等待天亮。

ex.s: At this moment, Gunter pointed towards the waiting hall of the bus station.
ex.t: 这时，冈特指了指汽车站的候车大厅。

ex.s: At this moment, Gunter pointed towards the waiting hall of the bus station.
ex.t: 这时，冈特指了指汽车站的候车大厅。

ex.s: The organizers had to cancel the outdoor concert due to the sudden thunderstorm, _________ many eager fans who had been waiting for hours.
ex.t: 组织者不得不因突如其来的雷暴取消户外音乐会，_________许多已经等待了数小时的狂热粉丝。

ex.s: He placed them in the tanks and waited.
ex.t: 他把它们放进水箱里等待。

ex.s: For the waiter’s rudeness.
ex.t: 因为服务员的无礼。

ex.s: They felt stressed while waiting for the sunset.
ex.t: 他们在等待日落时感到有压力。

ex.s: Several violins hung from the dark walls, quietly waiting to be chosen.
ex.t: 几把小提琴挂在暗色的墙上，静静地等待着被挑选。

ex.s: He didn’t attempt to walk back home; he waited and trusted.
ex.t: 他没有试图走回家；他等待着，信任着。

ex.s: If a session is full, you can register for the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果课程已满，你可以注册候补名单。

ex.s: When you are placed on a waiting list, we will email you a number which tells you where you are on the list.
ex.t: 当你被列入候补名单时，我们会发邮件给你一个号码，告诉你在名单上的位置。

ex.s: If you miss two PASS sessions in a row, you will be deregistered and your place will be given to someone on the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果你连续错过两次PASS课程，你将被取消注册，你的位置将给候补名单上的人。

ex.s: Sign up for the waiting list.
ex.t: 注册候补名单。

ex.s: had waitedB. has been waiting
ex.t: 已经等了 B. 一直在等待

ex.s: It’s better to leave your listeners wishing for more than shifting restlessly in their seats waiting for your speech finally to end.
ex.t: 与其让你的听众不安地在座位上挪动、等着你的演讲终于结束，不如让他们意犹未尽。

ex.s: After that I poured oil into a pan and turned off the stove, I waited patiently unless the oil was hot.
ex.t: 之后我把油倒入锅中，关掉了炉灶，我耐心等待直到油热了。

ex.s: A waiter’s job, for example, that requires multitasking, teamwork and decision-making could be just as stimulating as any high-level office work.
ex.t: 例如，服务员的工作需要多任务处理、团队协作和决策，可能与任何高层办公室工作一样具有刺激性。

ex.s: So what are you waiting for?
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 那你还在等什么呢？

ex.s: Marian Bechtel sits at West Palm Beach’s Bar Louie counter by herself, quietly reading her e-book as she waits for her salad.
ex.t: 玛丽安·贝克特尔独自坐在西棕榈滩Bar Louie餐厅的吧台前，安静地读着电子书，等待她的沙拉。

ex.s: “It’s not that talking to the waiter is better than talking to your husband,” say Dunn.
ex.t: "并不是说和服务员说话比和你丈夫说话更好，"邓恩说。

ex.s: On March 19, Dennis got a group text    44    him that a couple he didn’t know were at the hospital, waiting for the    45    of a baby.
ex.t: 3月19日，Dennis收到一条群发短信____44____，告诉他一对他不认识的夫妇在医院，等待着____45____（出生）一个婴儿。

ex.s: There a second set of partially inflated bags (shown in white) waited inside the hole.
ex.t: 在那里，第二组部分充气的气囊在坑内等候。

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 在发现一辆____18____宠物狗坐在停着的车的前座上、车窗摇下后，他在雨中守候了约两小时等待____19____主人回来。

ex.s: Now Alia waited for the war to end and  55  peace and a new library.
ex.t: 现在阿莉亚等待战争结束，并期盼和平与新图书馆的到来。

ex.s: And the only way for us to get into the habit of waiting is to practice. ___18___.
ex.t: 而我们养成等待习惯的唯一方法就是练习。___18___。

ex.s: Can't wait to see you back in school!
ex.t: 等不及想看到你回学校了！

ex.s: Today, there are over 4,000 people in London waiting for such pieces of land.
ex.t: 如今，伦敦有超过4000人在等待这样一块块土地。

ex.s: I don't want my friend to wait.
ex.t: 我不想让我的朋友等待。

ex.s: The cashier had scanned all the items and there were a couple of people ____13____ (wait) behind us.
ex.t: 收银员扫完了所有商品，有几位____13____（wait/等待）的人排在我们后面。

ex.s: Most stations wait about a year between visits.
ex.t: 大多数车站两次访问之间要等待大约一年。

ex.s: But it can certainly keep me entertained while I wait for my wife to rescue me.
ex.t: 但在我等待妻子来救我时，它肯定能让我开心解闷。

ex.s: Follow-up studies with the children later in life showed a connection between an ability to wait long enough to obtain a second treat and various forms of success.
ex.t: 后来的追踪研究显示了等待足够久以获得第二份零食的能力与各种形式的成功之间存在关联。

ex.s: Here’s a riddle: What do traffic jams, long lines and waiting for a vacation to start all have in common?
ex.t: 这里有个谜语：交通堵塞、排长队和等待假期开始有什么共同点？

ex.s: All kinds of human emotions are on display: sad (tearful goodbyes), happy (family get-togethers), anxious (waiting in a long line) and upset (missing a flight).
ex.t: 各种人类情感在这里展现：悲伤（含泪告别）、快乐（家庭团聚）、焦虑（排长队等候）和沮丧（错过航班）。

ex.s: I was performing this action of waiting until it later became  43  .Once that happened, I just kept   44  my studying further and further back in my day.
ex.t: 我一直在做这种"等待"的行为，直到后来它变成了____43____。一旦发生，我就把____44____学习一拖再拖，越推越后。

ex.s: ● Make yourself wait
ex.t: ● 让自己等待

ex.s: You might have to wait longer than 24 hours to catch the next one.
ex.t: 你可能需要等待超过24小时才能赶上下一班。

ex.s: He had to wait for the right _____55_____ to go back up.
ex.t: 他必须等待合适的_____55_____才能回去。

ex.s: They say good things come to those who wait; I say: grab every opportunity with everything you have and be impatient.
ex.t: 人们说好事多磨；我说：用你拥有的一切抓住每一个机会，要有紧迫感。

ex.s: Everything comes to those who wait.
ex.t: 好事多磨。

ex.s: is waitingD. would wait
ex.t: 正在等待 D. 会等待

ex.s: wait for seven days before getting it
ex.t: 等待七天后再去取

ex.s: Everyone was silent, wait to see who would be called upon to read his and her paragraph aloud.
ex.t: 大家都安静地等待，看谁会被叫起来大声朗读自己的段落。

ex.s: In fact, don’t wait until you’ve made a mistake to try this — it’s a great way to boost self-confidence at any time.
ex.t: 事实上，不要等到犯了错误才尝试这样做——这在任何时候都是增强自信的好方法。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展现自己。下次散步时，无论在哪里，都去感受所有的景象、声音和感觉。以这种心态漫步，你将为自己的生活打开一个新的维度。

defs.def: to hope or watch for sth to happen, especially for a long time （尤指长期地）希望，盼望，期待

ex.s: That cold Monday morning, he waited a long, long while for adults to ____9____.
ex.t: 那个寒冷的周一早晨，他等了很长很长时间让成年人____9____发现他。

ex.s: Time stood still as the bear and I both waited to see who would move first.
ex.t: 时间和我那只熊都静止了，我们等着看谁会先动。

ex.s: She’d watch me coming down her street, and by the time I’d biked up to her doorstep, there’d be a cold drink waiting.
ex.t: 她看着我沿着她的街道走过来，等我骑到她家门口时，那里已经放着一杯冷饮等着我了。

defs.def: to be ready for sb to have or use 事物

ex.s: He must have been waiting there for quite a while!
ex.t: 他一定在那里等了很久！

defs.def: to be left to be dealt with at a later time because it is not urgent 推迟；搁置；延缓

ex.s: Put off watching your favorite show until the weekend or wait 10 extra minutes before going for that cake.
ex.t: 把看你最喜欢的节目推迟到周末，或者在吃那块蛋糕之前多等十分钟。

defs.def: （要说出令人吃惊或高兴的事情）听着，听好了
（让人在得到通知前别做某事）等候通知

ex.s: Each child was told if they waited for 15 minutes before eating the treat, they would be given a second treat.
ex.t: 每个孩子都被告知，如果他们在吃零食前等15分钟，就会得到第二份零食。

ex.s: If they’re rushing into something and should wait and be patient, you could say”3 __________”.
ex.t: 如果他们急于做某事、本应等待并保持耐心，你可以说“3 __________”。

defs.def: to wait for a short time 等一会儿；稍等一下

ex.s: C．She couldn't wait to tear the newspaper apart．
ex.t: 然而，随着我逐渐成长，我曾经知道如此简单的世界正变得越来越复杂，我发现我需要一种逃避方式。通过打开一本小说，我可以把负担抛在脑后，进入一个美妙而神秘的世界，在那里我现在是一个新角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必写下发生了什么或者作者在写这本书时使用了什么技巧。我只是为了放松而读。
